profile: Knife River supplies aggregates-based construction materials and contracting services across multiple U.S. states. It mines and sells crushed stone, sand and gravel, produces asphalt and ready-mix concrete, and provides asphalt paving, heavy-civil and concrete construction, site development and grading. Some operations also manufacture prestressed concrete products. Customers include government agencies and other public-sector entities, industrial and commercial businesses, residential developers, and private parties.
